sections.title: 五、书面表达
prompts: 请以 'My Daily Life' 为题，写一篇不少于60词的短文。内容包括：1. 你每天的时间安排；2. 你最喜欢的科目或活动；3. 你对日常生活的感受。
modelAnswers: I usually get up at 6:30 in the morning. After breakfast, I go to school by bus. My favourite subject is English because it is interesting. In the afternoon, I play sports with my classmates. I go to bed at 9:30. I enjoy my daily life very much.

sections.title: 五、书面表达
prompts: 请以 'My Hobby' 为题，写一篇不少于80词的短文。内容包括：1. 你的爱好是什么；2. 你是如何发展这个爱好的；3. 这个爱好给你带来了什么。
modelAnswers: My hobby is playing the piano. I started learning it when I was seven years old. At first, it was difficult, but I kept practising every day. Now I can play many beautiful songs.
